comments: e2bb87c1: ; Set facility array references.
bd8b71d8: ; Flag to control exit processing.
1caca2f8: ; For each event - Movement, Appt, Dispositon and Admit; Initialize SDAPM API and call SDStart to process event.
71dc9c6a: ; Exit and kill variables.
94ad8e9f: ;Do not overwrite the current QA period if it exists and return.

10c7ae46: ;
 ;Entry point to determine and set the current QA period.
 ;If an active QA period exists then set CA and DGPMT to this period.
 ;If no active period exists then set CA and DGPMT to the default period.
664b8d5a: ;Set the current quarter/annual period to the active QA period if it exists, otherwise use the default.
b505d0a5: ;Set the period type (quarterly or annual) to the active QA period if it exists, otherwise use the default.
4a1527f9: ;If the default period is annual and there is no active period then quit.
e0e163ae: Inform the user that incomplete records are being updated if DGQUIET is not defined or has a false value.
4b1dc4d2: Reset DGONE to 0 after the message has been displayed.
37371ed1: Execute the DIK utility, which is used for data manipulation and record deletion.
3f772026: Call the WARD^DGJTUTL routine, which likely retrieves or processes ward-related information.

5803c285: If X contains a value, store the value in DGJTWARD and retrieve the division name from the INSTITUTION file (^DIC(42)) using the ward code, and store it in DGJTDIV. If the ward code is not found in the file, DGJTDIV is set to an empty string.
7f38ea2e: If the 'DT' node does not exist, or if it is 0, then quit out of the code.
c7987c58: If DGONE is true and DGQUIET is not defined or false, write a message to the screen that says 'Updating incomplete records...' and set DGONE to 0.
a3ee0e7c: If the ^UTILITY global node exists at the current job's 6th subscript, set DGJTSIFN to the next available subscript after 6.
1f018286: Call the DIS routine and then quit.
64d9cce9: Delete all entries in the ^VAS(393 global where the 'ADM' cross-reference matches DGPMDA. This is done using the ^DIK utility.
d547cc0e: Clear the variables DIK, DA, and DGJDIK before quitting.
6f3fd896: Initialize variable DR for later use.
abe5ac3b: Set DGJTADM to the admission date from either DGPMP or DGPMA if available, otherwise set it to null. If DGJTADM is null, quit to DISQ label.
11ba6567: Loop through the VAS(393) file, finding entries with an admission date matching DGJTADM and a status of '1' (active). Quit the loop when such an entry is found.
d199a159: ;If input parameter I is defined and not null, set DGJTDA to I.
a56de695: ;If DGPMT=2 (edit mode), input parameter I is defined, DGPMA does not equal DGPMP, and ^UTILITY("DGPM",$J,6) does not exist, call the CHNG routine and quit.

d34d01a5: ;If DGPMT=1 (add mode) or DGPMT=3 (delete mode), and DGPMA is defined but input parameter I is not defined, call the NEW routine. If DGPMT=3 (delete mode), quit after calling NEW. Otherwise, if DGPMT=1 (add mode), call the CK routine, set DIE to ^VAS(393,, set DA to DGJTDA, call ^DIE, and quit.
06b57fda: Delete the movement's entry in the MOVEMENT COMMENTS file if it is a delete transaction, the delete transaction is allowed, and the movement does not have an admission associated with it.
28e7c93d: If it is an add transaction and the admission and movement are different, call the CK and CHNG routines to perform checks and update the movement.

d89d9fec: If it is an edit transaction and the admission and movement are different, update the admission associated with the movement, set the DGJTCA flag to indicate a change, and call the CHNG routine to update the movement.

6ff41b08: If it is an edit transaction, the movement does not have an admission, and the movement has a pointer to an admission, set the DGPMA variable to the admission pointed to by the movement and call the NEW routine.
dc0b68d2: If it is an edit transaction, exit.
3950b482: If it is an add transaction, set the DGJTCA flag to the movement's internal entry number.
3bf5d4da: If the movement's admission and movement comments in the utility global are different, call the CHNG routine to update the movement.

72ee6368: If the movement's admission and movement comments in the utility global are the same, but the admission associated with the movement is different from the movement's admission, call the CHNG routine to update the movement.
7c9454be: ;Kill all variables used in this routine.
bbcaa8b5: ;Store the appointment multiple entry data node in DGJT
003936cf: Assign the value stored in ^DG(40.8,+DGJTDIV,"DT") to DGJTP if it exists, otherwise assign an empty string.
c8b796f1: Assign the value stored in ^DIC(42,DGJTWARD,44) to DGJTWD if the node ^DIC(42,DGJTWARD,0) exists, otherwise assign an empty string.
80a6c453: If DGJTWARD is not empty, assign the 3rd piece of ^DIC(42,+DGJTWARD,0) to DGJTSV, otherwise assign an empty string.

4b7c0a70: If DGJTSV is not an empty string, check if a cross-reference entry exists in ^DG(393.1,"AC",DGJTSV). If it exists, assign the first entry to DGJTSV, otherwise, assign the first entry in ^DG(393.1,"AC",0,0) to DGJTSV. If DGJTSV is still an empty string after this, assign 0 to it.
8c84f29b: Write the document name and service date to the array.
062e8940: Set the position and alignment if the processing type is message or registration and document is an appointment.
d372d185: Quit if the patient movement type is either intra-facility transfer or AA patient movement.
8823ff76: Quit if the transfer/admission has already been processed.
793f8fdb: Create a new entry in the PATIENT MOVEMENT file (#393) for the patient.
64db8615: Get the IEN of the 'INCOMPLETE' status in the PATIENT STATUS file (#393.2).
e02fe899: If a new entry was created, set up variables to update the entry.
c3b947cc: ;Set the field values for the new entry.
0def0681: Update the entry that was selected in the list.
73934e3f: Perform cleanup and quit the routine.
c1d07288: If the payment is a type 1, 2, or 3, set the fields .05 to the transfer date, .06 to the transfer division.
b340475c: Set fields .07 to the legacy DFN, .08 to the payment source, .09 to the legacy payment type, and .1 to the legacy payment type name or '@' if blank.
a1061950: Perform cleanup.
b54f525f: Quit the routine.
a02f53ea: Get the document type from DGJTP.
f839ffb4: Set X to the document pointer if type A, empty for type N, or the legacy document pointer otherwise.
ff45c4fd: Exit if unable to get information from ^DGPM.
c9455d00: If the application is succesful, set the patient's primary physician and file the changes.
c11b0ecf: Check if the patient has a primary physician defined. If not, use the system date/time.
add86427: If the patient has a primary physician defined, use the primary physician's file entry date.
a89280cb: Update the primary physician assignment date field with the date found above.
